nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of NiCuMo_x LDH series
nodes.procedure: A series of NiCuMo LDH materials (x = 0.1, 0.2, 0.3) were firstly in situ preparation on Ni foam (NF) using typical hydrothermal reaction.
nodes.source_text: In this work, A series of NiCuMo LDH materials were firstly in situ preparation on Ni foam (NF) using typical hydrothermal reaction. The interconnected NiCuMo0.2 LDH with urchin-like structure displays enhanced synergistic catalysis.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD spectrum of NiCuMo_x (x = 0.1, 0.2, 0.3) LDH shows characteristic peaks at 16.8°, 23.6°, 31.2°, 33.8°, 37.6°, 38.2°, 47.2°, 54.6°, 57.2°, 61.8° and 63.6° matching Cu(OH)₂ planes and peaks at 14.9°, 26.2°, 35.2°, 42.4°, 56.2° and 57.3° matching Ni(OH)₂ planes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) spectrum of the obtained NiCuMo_x (x = 0.1, 0.2 and 0.3) LDH is displayed in Fig. 1a ... well matched with the (020), (021), (110), (002), (041), (022), (112), (061), (151), (113) and (043) planes of Cu(OH)₂, respectively (PDF#72-0140).

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows NiCuMo_x (x = 0.1, 0.2) LDH/NF with uniformly covered urchin-like structures on Ni foam; NiCuMo0.3 LDH/NF shows more nanoneedles and less urchin-like structures.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 1b-e, the morphology of the NiCuMo_x (x = 0.1, 0.2 and 0.3) LDH/NF was researched by scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The surface of Ni foam support was uniformly covered by NiCuMo_x (x = 0.1 and 0.2) LDH/NF urchin-like structures.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows NiCuMo0.2 LDH displays unique urchin-like structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As you can see from Fig. 2a, it can be observed that the NiCuMo0.2 LDH display unique urchin-like structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows interplanar spacings of 0.46 nm and 0.53 nm, indexed to (001) planes of Ni(OH)₂ and (020) plane of Cu(OH)₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HRTEM image in Fig. 2b shows interplanar spacings of 0.46 and 0.53 nm, which was indexed to the (001) planes of Ni(OH)₂ and (020) diffraction plane of Cu(OH)₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS element mapping shows Ni, Cu, Mo and O homogeneously dispersed over the marked area of NiCuMo0.2 LDH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The EDS element mapping images of Ni, Cu, Mo and O are shown in Fig. 2c. Obviously, it can be seen that Ni, Cu, Mo and O were homogeneously dispersed over the marked area.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS of NiCuMo0.2 LDH shows survey with Ni, Mo, Cu, O, C only; Cu 2p3/2 at 934.5 eV, 2p1/2 at 954.0 eV (shifted higher vs NiCu LDH indicating Mo electron configuration adjustment); Ni 2p2/3 at 855.4 eV, 2p1/3 at 874.5 eV; Mo 3d5/2 at 232.2 eV, 3d3/2 at 235.8 eV; O 1s at 530.5 eV (M-O), 532.0 eV (Ov), 533.2 eV (surface O).
nodes.evidence_snippet: As displayed in Fig. 3a, only Ni, Mo, Cu, O and C elements existed in full scan spectrum and no other impurities were observed. For the fine spectrum of Cu 2p (Fig. 3b), Cu 2p3/2 peaks and Cu 2p1/2 peaks located at 934.5 eV and 954.0 eV ... XPS characterization demonstrated that NiCuMo LDH/NF was successfully prepared.

nodes.characterization_summary: LSV shows NiCuMo0.2 LDH overpotential of 290 mV@40 mA cm⁻², better than NiCuMo0.3 LDH (300 mV), NiCuMo0.1 LDH (310 mV), RuO₂ (340 mV), NiCu LDH (320 mV).
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 4a ... the linear sweep voltammetry (LSV) curves demonstrate that NiCuMo0.2 LDH displays a low overpotential of 290 mV to drive 40 mA cm⁻².

nodes.characterization_summary: Tafel slopes: NiCuMo0.2 LDH 39.8 mV dec⁻¹, NiCuMo0.3 LDH 73.8 mV dec⁻¹, NiCuMo0.1 LDH 109.2 mV dec⁻¹, NiCu LDH 123.3 mV dec⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As displayed in Fig. 4b, the Tafel slope of NiCuMo0.2 LDH is as small as 39.8 mV dec⁻¹, which are lower than Tafel plots of NiCuMo0.3 LDH (73.8 mV dec⁻¹).

nodes.characterization_summary: CV determines double-layer capacitance C_dl of NiCuMo_x (x=0.1,0.2,0.3) LDH as highest 5.7 mF cm⁻² for NiCuMo0.2 LDH vs 3.4 mF cm⁻² for NiCu LDH, indicating more electrocatalytic active centers from Mo doping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the electrochemically active surface area (ECSA) of NiCuMox (x=0.1, 0.2 and 0.3) LDH material was determined ... from the double-layer capacitance (C_dl). It is worth mentioning that the NiCuMo LDH material show the highest C_dl of 5.7 mF cm⁻², which is larger than C_dl of undoped NiCu LDH (3.4 mF cm⁻²).

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows NiCuMo0.2 LDH has much lower charge transfer resistance than undoped NiCu LDH/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The charge transfer resistance of NiCuMo0.2 LDH is obviously much lower than that of undoped NiCu LDH/NF, which further demonstrate the NiCuMo0.2 LDH/NF have faster electron transfer rate.
